title: Trans–New Guinea languages - Wikipedia
text: Trans–New Guinea is an extensive family of Papuan languages spoken on the island of New Guinea and neighboring islands, a region corresponding to the country Papua New Guinea as well as parts of Indonesia.

text: Central New Guinea Highlands. East Trans Fly.Onobasulu has a body-part counting system of the type characteristic of the New Guinea region in which the term for the number is identical to that for the body part which is touched during tallying.

title: Onobasulu Language (ONN) – L1 & L2 Speakers... | Ethnologue Free
text: Onobasulu is a stable indigenous language of Papua New Guinea. It belongs to the Trans-New Guinea language family. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community.

title: Onobasulu language — Grokipedia
text: Onobasulu is a Trans–New Guinea language of the Bosavi branch spoken by approximately 1,000 to 1,600 people primarily in the Bosavi region of Southern Highlands and Hela Provinces, Papua New Guinea.
